rca of the issue: RBAC: Multiple distinct endpoints across admin/shop/dispatch/safety namespaces return 200 anonymously, AND /api/shop/fleet/by-unit accepts arbitrary X-Shop-Token / X-Dispatch-Token / X-Safety-Token strings. This rules out 'one missing decorator' and points to a dependency-injection regression — likely the require_* FastAPI Depends used by these routers returns None on missing/invalid token instead of raising HTTPException(401). Reproduction: `curl https://safety-audit-mobile-1.preview.emergentagent.com/api/shop/fleet/by-unit` returns 200 JSON with full fleet data. Mitigation: (1) audit routes/fleet_ops.py + routes/integrations/_deps.py for require_admin / require_shop_or_admin / make_require_any_portal_token; (2) confirm each raises HTTPException(401) on missing AND invalid token; (3) re-run iter256 test file — must hit 44/44.
verdict: BLOCK — do not deploy to production. RBAC must be fixed and re-verified.
